main.AGENTS.md:
# Ledger App agent guidance

Ledger App is the customer billing portal: invoices, plans, and account settings.

- Run `pnpm test` before opening a pull request.
- Code under `app/billing/` and `db/migrations/` moves money or stored data. Treat it as sensitive.
- Customer-facing views live in `app/views/`.

418.title: Refactor: rename formatCents to formatMinorUnits
418.body:
Pure rename, no behavior change.

`formatCents` was a misleading name for zero-decimal currencies, so this renames it to
`formatMinorUnits` everywhere. Mechanical find-and-replace across callers and the test.
No migration or API impact.
